from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import signal
import sys
import time


_READY = b"engram-nest-guardian-ready-v1\n"


def _parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    parser.add_argument("--group-leader-pid", type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-session-id", type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--test-mode",
        choices=(
            "normal",
            "hang-before-ready",
            "eof-before-ready",
            "exit-after-ready-delay",
        ),
        default="normal",
    )
    return parser


def _pause_forever() -> None:
    """Retain the live group anchor when the one safe signal cannot close it."""

    while True:
        signal.pause()


def _signal_anchored_group_once(process_group_id: int) -> None:
    """Send one signal while the original guardian still anchors the PGID."""

    try:
        os.killpg(process_group_id, signal.SIGKILL)
    except OSError:
        # Keep the original guardian alive as the exact PGID anchor. No caller
        # may retry through the bare numeric identifier after that anchor exits.
        _pause_forever()


def _seal_group_after_owner_loss(process_group_id: int) -> None:
    """Signal the anchored group once without later reusing its numeric PGID."""

    try:
        child = os.fork()
    except OSError:
        _signal_anchored_group_once(process_group_id)
        os._exit(71)
    if child == 0:
        try:
            os.setpgid(0, 0)
        except OSError:
            _signal_anchored_group_once(process_group_id)
            os._exit(72)
        _signal_anchored_group_once(process_group_id)
        os._exit(0)
    _pause_forever()


def main() -> int:
    """Anchor one group until its owner seals it or loses the control pipe."""

    arguments = _parser().parse_args()
    test_mode = arguments.test_mode
    process_group_id = os.getpgrp()

        arguments.group_leader_pid < 2
        or arguments.expected_session_id < 2
        or process_group_id != arguments.group_leader_pid
        or os.getpid() == process_group_id
        or os.getsid(0) != arguments.expected_session_id
    ):
        return 78
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)
    if test_mode == "hang-before-ready":
        while True:
            signal.pause()
    if test_mode == "eof-before-ready":
        return 71
    os.write(sys.stdout.fileno(), _READY)
    os.close(sys.stdout.fileno())
    if test_mode == "exit-after-ready-delay":
        time.sleep(0.25)
        return 72
    while os.read(sys.stdin.fileno(), 4_096):
        pass
    _seal_group_after_owner_loss(process_group_id)
    return 70


if __name__ == "__main__":
